relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Developing small molecules to reduce channel conductance in a subtype-specific manner has been challenging but the Nav1.8 channel blocker, suzetrigine, has finally reached the clinic.

relationships.subject: voltage-gated sodium channels
relationships.evidence_quote: Voltage-gated sodium channels (Nav) play a fundamental role in generating action potentials in excitable cells including nociceptors.

key_findings: Review: suzetrigine, a Nav1.8 blocker, is the first subtype-selective Nav analgesic to reach the clinic.
Alternative Nav-selective strategies include aptamers/oligonucleotides, RNA editing, antibodies and targeted protein degradation.
